outcome: distribution of procedures by hospital level
cohort: Data were obtained for ObGyn operations performed on females aged 12 years and over, and live births, in Ghana between 2014 and 2015.
finding: The national cesarean delivery rate of 7.2% suggests inadequate access to obstetric care, and the cesarean-to-total-operation ratio (CTR) of 0.27 suggests inadequate overall surgical capacity in Ghana.
mod_finding: The national rate of cesarean deliveries was 7.2% and constituted 80% of essential ObGyn procedures.
